addons.name: BentoBox
addons.description:
**BentoBox** is the core plugin. Every game mode and addon on this page needs it.

It provides island protection, teams, settings flags, blueprints and the API that game modes and addons build on.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: AcidIsland
addons.description:
**AcidIsland** is a **survival game** where players try to survive and expand their island, surrounded by a **sea of acid**.

Acid is everywhere. Acid burns everything.

Oh, and rain is acid too.

Created and maintained by tastybento.

addons.name: AOneBlock
addons.description:
**AOneBlock** is a OneBlock **survival game**

You spawn on a block. Just *one* block. What do you do?

Created and maintained by tastybento.

addons.name: Boxed
addons.description:
**Boxed** is a semi-vanilla **survival game**.

You start boxed into a tiny space that only **expands as you complete advancements**.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: BSkyBlock
addons.description:
**BSkyBlock** is classic **SkyBlock**: players start on a small **island in the sky** with limited resources and build their way up.

The successor to the original ASkyBlock.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: CaveBlock
addons.description:
**CaveBlock** is a **survival game** where players try to survive **underground**.

*An ode to the dwarf's heart in the depths of each person.*

Based on an original idea by the **StoneBlock modpack**.

Created and maintained by BONNe.

addons.name: SkyGrid
addons.description:
**SkyGrid** is a **survival game** set in a world **made up of scattered blocks** floating over the void.

Every resource is one wrong step from a fall.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: Poseidon
addons.description:
**Poseidon** is an **underwater survival game**. Players are shipwrecked and must breathe, build and survive in an aquatic world.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: Parkour
addons.description:
**Parkour** lets players **build parkour courses** and challenge others to run them.

Courses have start and finish plates, checkpoints and best-time leaderboards.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: TradeWinds
addons.description:
**TradeWinds** is a game mode of **sea trading, smuggling and piracy**.

Start with a rowing boat on an endless ocean of NPC trading islands. Buy low, sell high, upgrade your boat, dodge customs and pirates, and earn the right to claim an island of your own.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: ChunkBlock
addons.description:
**One Block, One Chunk**

You start on a single magic block, confined to a single chunk. Everything beyond it is a forbidden zone — you literally cannot leave. Mine the magic block, build, and raise your island level: every level unlocks the next chunk in a spiral of rings around your starting chunk. Lose levels (deaths, removing blocks) and your outermost chunks lock again — your builds stay, but you can't reach them until you earn the level back.

addons.name: Bank
addons.description:
**Bank** gives island teams a **shared bank account** with interest, statements and a ranking of the richest islands.

Requires Vault and an economy plugin.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: Biomes
addons.description:
**Biomes** lets your players **change the biome** on their island.

Created and maintained by [BONNe](https://github.com/bonne).

addons.name: Border
addons.description:
**Border** displays a **border** around your players' islands.

Choose the vanilla world border or a barrier-block and particle border.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: CauldronWitchery
addons.description:
**CauldronWitchery** gives your players the opportunity to get their hands on **black magic**.
Let them **spawn monsters** using a cauldron!

*What does the Witch do with her cauldron?*
*Black Magic, of course!*

*We are just not sure what could happen afterward...*

Based on an original idea by the **Ex Nihilo mod**.

Created and maintained by [BONNe](https://github.com/BONNe).

addons.name: Challenges
addons.description:
**Challenges** lets you create Challenges for your **players to complete**, with rewards and optional levels to unlock.

Created and maintained by [BONNe](https://github.com/BONNe).

addons.name: Chat
addons.description:
**Chat** lets your players **chat with each other** in an **Island Chat** or a **Team Chat**.

Admins can spy on either channel.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: CheckMeOut
addons.description:
**CheckMeOut** lets players **submit their island** for review by admins.

Use it to run server-wide build competitions. Admins get a GUI listing submissions and can teleport to each island, then delete a submission or clear them all when the event is over.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: ControlPanel
addons.description:
**ControlPanel** lets you design a flexible **Control Panel** your players can use to **manage their island**.

Created and maintained by [BONNe](https://github.com/BONNe).

addons.name: DeathChest
addons.description:
**DeathChest** saves a player's items into a **chest** when they die instead of dropping them, and it knows where **islands** are.

*Fell into the void? Drowned in the acid sea?*
*Your chest goes to your own island instead of being lost.*

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: DimensionalTrees
addons.description:
**DimensionalTrees** lets you define **exotic tree types** in **other dimensions**.

*Have you ever dreamed of a glowstone tree in the Nether?*
*What about an end stone and purpur tree in the End?*

Created by [Awakened-Redstone](https://github.com/Awakened-Redstone) and maintained by the [BentoBoxWorld Crew](https://github.com/orgs/BentoBoxWorld/teams/crew).

addons.name: ExtraMobs
addons.description:
**ExtraMobs** changes some mob-spawning rules to make **Shulkers**, **Wither Skeletons** and more **spawn naturally in your worlds**.

Created and maintained by [BONNe](https://github.com/BONNe).

addons.name: FarmersDance
addons.description:
**FarmersDance** lets players **dance** (crouch repeatedly) next to any growable plant to make it **grow faster**.

Unlike TwerkingForTrees, it works on crops, cactus, pumpkins, mushrooms and more.

Created and maintained by [BONNe](https://github.com/BONNe).

addons.name: Greenhouses
addons.description:
**Greenhouses** lets your players **create biome greenhouses** on their islands.

An alternative to the Biomes addon.

Adapted from tastybento's Greenhouses plugin.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: InvSwitcher
addons.description:
**InvSwitcher** gives players a **separate inventory per world**.

It works with any game mode. The following can be switched per world:

* Inventory & armor
* Advancements
* Food level
* Experience
* Health
* Ender chest contents

Use the config to choose what is switched.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: IslandFly
addons.description:
**IslandFly** lets your players **fly within their islands**!

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: Level
addons.description:
**Level** creates a competitive atmosphere by making your players try to **have the highest island level**.

Islands are scored by the blocks on them, with a Top Ten leaderboard.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: Likes
addons.description:
**Likes** lets your players leave **likes or dislikes** on **islands they visit**.

Created and maintained by [BONNe](https://github.com/BONNe).

addons.name: Limits
addons.description:
**Limits** lets you limit how many **blocks and entities** your players can have on their islands.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: MagicCobblestoneGenerator
addons.description:
**MagicCobblestoneGenerator** gives players a simple and effective way to **generate resources** on their islands.

- **Generator tiers** that unlock as islands progress
- **Per-game-mode tiers**, or disable it in chosen game modes
- **Offline generation** can be turned off for islands with no members online

Created and maintained by [BONNe](https://github.com/BONNe).

addons.name: Stranger Realms
addons.description:
**StrangerRealms** is a **survival game** where the Nether is replaced by the **Upside Down**: a dark, block-for-block copy of the Overworld full of corrupted mobs.

Claim land that is protected in both dimensions.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: TwerkingForTrees
addons.description:
**TwerkingForTrees** lets your players **twerk** that cubic booty to get trees **growing faster**!

Inspired by the modded Skyblock experience.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: Visit
addons.description:
**Visit** lets your players **visit other islands**.

Unlike Warps, no signs are needed: players can travel to any island that allows visitors.

Created and maintained by [BONNe](https://github.com/BONNe).

addons.name: VoidPortals
addons.description:
**VoidPortals** lets your players teleport to other dimensions by **jumping into the void**!

Created and maintained by [BONNe](https://github.com/BONNe).

addons.name: Warps
addons.description:
**Warps** lets your players create Warps so that other players can visit their islands.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: TopBlock
addons.description:
**TopBlock** shows a **Top Ten** of islands in AOneBlock and ChunkBlock, ranked by how many magic blocks they have mined.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: Lag Budget
addons.description:
**Lag Budget** gives every island a **lag budget**. When an island goes over budget, new spawns there are silently dropped. Nothing is blocked and players get no message. Optionally, hopper transfers can be dropped too.

Admins can see what is going on with `/<admin> lagbudget top` and `/<admin> lagbudget info <player>`.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).

addons.name: Upgrades
addons.description:
**Upgrades** lets players **buy island upgrades**: a bigger protection range, higher block and entity limits, and custom command rewards.

Uses Vault for costs. Works with the Level and Limits addons.

Created and maintained by [tastybento](https://github.com/tastybento).
